lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Rooftop lessons taught you to move. Today you learn to fight, and to fall without breaking.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: I already know how to fall.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Not the way I mean. Chain your pushes tight enough and the mists will carry you faster than any guard can run. Then Ham's going to hit you, and you're going to enjoy it a little.
